name: hammer-mcp
description: Inspect and edit saved Hammer VMF/VMAP maps, connect entity I/O, and run native compiler jobs.

interface.longDescription: Saved-map integration for Valve Hammer. Includes 18 MCP tools for VMF/VMAP inspection, entity edits, I/O, templates, FGD search, native compile jobs and recoverable backups. Source 2 binary maps use the installed Valve DMX converter. Live editor UI control is not included.
defaultPrompt: 해머 MCP로 설치된 게임과 맵 작업 환경을 확인해줘.
이 맵의 엔티티와 I/O 연결을 검사해줘.
해머 MCP로 테스트 맵을 만들고 컴파일해줘.
